title: Clarify single-user mailbox model in architecture comments
description: The code implements a single-user global delivery model where all authenticated sessions see the same mailbox and only one Sieve script (_global) is evaluated. This is mentioned in scattered context-specific comments (e.g., session.rs line 789) but not documented at the architectural level. A future maintainer might try to add per-user mailbox isolation without realizing this violates the design invariants. Add or consolidate high-level documentation explaining: (1) all sessions see the same JMAP mailbox, (2) Sieve is global (not per-user), (3) why this design was chosen.
